hook: What if a 90-foot landmark simply vanished into the Pacific Ocean?

sections.voiceover: What if a 90-foot landmark simply vanished into the Pacific Ocean?
The Hōlei Sea Arch in Hawaiʻi Volcanoes National Park stood at the end of Chain of Craters Road. How did this massive formation disappear?
Rough storms battered the coast, causing the Hōlei Sea Arch to collapse by September 27, 2026.
The Guardian reported that the structure fell by the night of September 27, 2026. Ocean erosion and volcanic geography made its eventual collapse inevitable. The 90-foot arch is now gone.
That 90-foot height is now just a memory in Hawaiʻi.
